Both get flagged at 80%+. Both face the same penalty. The system doesn't care about intent—it only sees patterns.

Here's what they don't tell you in freshman orientation:

Turnitin's AI detector has a 12% false positive rate. That's 1 in 8 students getting flagged for work they actually wrote. GPTZero is worse—26% false positives in Stanford's study. Originality.ai flagged Shakespeare as AI-generated in a viral test last month.

Definitely AI.
